chain.title: The Fifth Archwood
chain.desc: Ars Nouveau ships four archwoods. Flashing Archwood is the fifth, generating in its own biome set through data/ars_elemental/forge/biome_modifier, and its wood is a reagent the base mod has no equivalent for.

chain.title: Fruit That Holds A Charge
chain.desc: The Flashpine pod is Ars Elemental's magic fruit, sitting beside Ars Nouveau's mendosteen, bastion, frostaya and bombegranate. It is the reagent for every lightning glyph here.

chain.title: An Element, Narrowed
chain.desc: Imbuement Chamber: fire essence, an amethyst shard and gold. The lesser foci give a flat damage bonus to one element and are the cheap half of the mod's central mechanic.

chain.title: Static, Weaponised
chain.desc: Glyph recipe: air essence, iron bars and wool. Spark shocks the target and hits wet enemies harder - Ars Elemental's whole lightning school starts here.

chain.title: Cashing In The Charge
chain.desc: Glyph recipe: flashpine pod, air essence and a lightning rod. Discharge detonates a shocked target and chains outward, empowered if the shock came from static build-up.

chain.title: Essence Of The Not-Quite-Dead
chain.desc: Imbuement Chamber: source gem, bone meal, a golden apple and a wither skeleton skull. Anima is a sixth school Ars Nouveau does not have, and it gates the necromancy line.

chain.title: Proof You Learned All Six
chain.desc: The Enchanting Apparatus consumes one essence of every school at once - air, water, earth, fire, manipulation, abjuration, conjuration and anima. It is the mod's single hardest gate and every greater focus and elemental robe needs one.

chain.title: The Element, Mastered
chain.desc: Enchanting Apparatus: a lesser focus plus the Mark of Mastery. Greater foci convert your spell damage wholesale to that element instead of merely adding to it.

chain.title: The Pyromancer's Crown
chain.desc: An armour upgrade on an Ars Nouveau hood using fire essence, netherite and the Mark of Mastery. Four elemental sets exist; each biases mana discount toward its own school.

chain.title: A Ring Worth Attuning
chain.desc: Enchanting Apparatus: Ring of Potential, a source block, an end crystal and gold. The blank bangle is the base every elemental bangle is imbued from.

chain.title: Wearing The Element
chain.desc: Base bangle, fire essence and a fire charge. Bangles are Curios-slot passives, one per element, and stack with the matching focus.

chain.title: Bouncing The Beam
chain.desc: Enchanting Apparatus: quartz, archwood logs, a source block and gold. Placed on a wall, floor or ceiling it reflects an incoming spell projectile at a mirrored angle.

chain.title: A Prism With Lenses
chain.desc: Ars Nouveau's Spell Prism with quartz and a source gem. The advanced version accepts prism lenses, which is what turns a projectile relay into a programmable one.

chain.title: Teaching The Beam To Follow
chain.desc: Imbuement: the Homing Projectile glyph, manipulation essence and quartz. Slotted into an advanced prism it makes every projectile passing through it seek a target.

chain.title: A Turret With An Element
chain.desc: Imbuement: fire focus, fire essence and an Ars Nouveau Spell Turret. Infused turrets bake the focus into the turret so it does not need one equipped.

chain.title: Casting On Everyone At Once
chain.desc: Enchanting Apparatus: air essence, a wilden horn, a source gem and gold. Hold to charge; it casts an inscribed spell on yourself and everything nearby, with a spell-damage buff at full charge.

chain.title: The Summoner Who Raises
chain.desc: Enchanting Apparatus: anima essence, a Summon Focus, a wither rose and a wither skeleton skull. It turns Ars Nouveau's summoning into necromancy.

chain.title: More Things At Once
chain.desc: Base bangle, conjuration essence, a wilden horn and bone. It raises your summon cap, which is the only way to run a full necrotic build.

chain.title: A Pot That Never Empties
chain.desc: Enchanting Apparatus: water essence, source gem, a flower pot and a prismarine shard. An infinite water source for automation that does not need a two-by-two pool.

chain.title: The Song In The Reef
chain.desc: Sirens spawn in their own biome tag through data/ars_elemental/forge/biome_modifier/siren_spawns.json. They are the wild form of the familiar and the source of Siren Tokens.

chain.title: A Token From The Water
chain.desc: Siren Tokens drop from wild sirens and are the reagent the Siren Charm needs.

chain.title: Binding The Song
chain.desc: Enchanting Apparatus: siren tokens, a source gem, fish and a prismarine shard. The charm binds a Siren familiar that buffs you underwater.

chain.title: Binding The Cannon
chain.desc: Enchanting Apparatus: fire essence, a magma block, nether brick and netherite scrap. The Flarecannon familiar is the fire counterpart to the Siren and fires on your targets.

chain.title: Sewing Summoning Into Cloth
chain.desc: Enchanting Apparatus: blank thread, conjuration essence, a wilden drop and an echo shard. Armour threads are Ars Nouveau's upgrade slot; this one boosts the summoning school.

notes: 83 ids resolve as assets/ars_elemental/models/item/<id>.json intersected with item./block. lang keys. The 27 glyphs need a THIRD proof because Ars Nouveau glyphs carry no item./block. lang key: each one here has (a) an item model, (b) an ars_elemental.glyph_name.<stem> lang entry, and (c) a data/ars_elemental/recipes entry of type ars_nouveau:glyph. All three had to match before the id was accepted. Recipe types used for ordering: ars_nouveau:imbuement (Imbuement Chamber), ars_nouveau:enchanting_apparatus, ars_nouveau:armor_upgrade, ars_nouveau:glyph and ars_nouveau:caster_tome. mark_of_mastery is the real spine of this mod: it needs one essence of all eight Ars Nouveau schools plus this mod's own anima_essence, and it gates all four greater foci and all sixteen elemental armour pieces. ENTITY AUDIT: all 21 entity.ars_elemental.* lang keys are registered class constants, but only siren_entity, firenando_entity and the four rogue mages are actual mobs - the other fifteen are summon-projectile and spell-effect entities (homing_projectile, lerp, ice_spike, dripstone_spike, linger_magnet, the seven summon_* familiar bodies) and would make uncompletable kill tasks. Only siren_entity is quested, because data/ars_elemental/forge/biome_modifier/siren_spawns.json proves it spawns naturally; the rogue mages have no spawn data in the jar and are left out. stripped_yellow_archwood, stripped_yellow_archwood_log and the sourcestone slab/stair/wall variants are excluded per the measured stripped_/_slab/_stairs/_wall rule. Parent items this addon assumes you already have: ars_nouveau:worn_notebook, an Enchanting Apparatus with arcane pedestals, ars_nouveau:imbuement_chamber, ars_nouveau:source_gem and a source jar network, all eight ars_nouveau:*_essence types, ars_nouveau:spell_book, ars_nouveau:hood / robe / legs / boot (the Sorceror armour set), ars_nouveau:ring_of_potential, ars_nouveau:spell_turret, ars_nouveau:spell_prism, ars_nouveau:wilden_horn, ars_nouveau:blank_thread, ars_nouveau:summon_focus, ars_nouveau:shapers_focus.
